notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.notes:
Firstly bugs


 Clipping through wall as been looked at. 
 Being locked in room on practice mode has been changed.


New Features


 On death at you game will display hints and tips while it loads. 


Sound


 The scream on death has been removed and replaced with a different sound.


Item


 Spawns have been changed to make things a little bit easier to find.
 Items now have light so easier to see/find.
 The torch has been made brighter so you can see more.
